behaviors.behavior: A plugin with scripts/ is measured from its own CWD
A plugin without scripts/ is not instrumented at all
shared and integration tiers measure shared/
--cov-config is the ABSOLUTE root pyproject
Each shared unit writes its OWN data file; no --cov-append
Colliding labels fail closed before any process starts
No root pyproject.toml means nothing is instrumented
instrument_for_coverage resolves a relative project root / data dir
Coverage args never split the -m marker expression
An instrumented unit gets its own COVERAGE_FILE
An uninstrumented unit does not inherit an ambient COVERAGE_FILE
run_suite reports the data files it told units to write

behaviors.behavior: A project that cannot be measured reports nothing rather than breakage
main hands the gate the data FILES, not a count
main exits 4 and surfaces diff-cover's own report
Exit precedence: suite rc > unrecorded race > coverage gate
warm_up provisions the package instrumentation adds
gate_argv mirrors the CI action's command shape, positionally
The gate consumes one coherent final-worktree patch that includes untracked and excludes ignored files
Pinned version, threshold, and compare ref equal the action's declared defaults
ci.yml keeps the diff-coverage gate as the backstop
combine_argv delegates to the ONE combiner implementation
eligible == 0 is an n/a PASS (nothing to gate)
The no-config cause is named distinctly from no-source-root
Instrumented units but no combined XML fails closed
A failed combine fails closed
Below threshold fails and names locally-skipping tests as a cause
A broken diff-cover or uvx rc=1 without diff-cover's pinned threshold message is NOT reported as a threshold verdict
No compare branch fails closed naming git fetch
A unit that wrote no data is named, and gating stops before combining; pytest-cov xdist suffixes still count as present
A red suite skips the gate, compare fetch, and coherent-diff builder entirely
Every subprocess failure mode is a closed gate, never a traceback
Stale or foreign state is fail-closed, and only this invocation's unique combine candidate is trusted
Compare-branch parity uses a bounded non-interactive refresh of CI's origin/main, ignores origin/HEAD, and names history deepening when no merge base exists

End to end with the REAL pinned diff-cover: uncovered fails, covered passes, mixed committed plus dirty line shifts use final coordinates, both tiers combine repo-relative, the CLI returns 4 then 0, and the existing race-followup path remains green under the permanent gate
behaviors.evidence: test_an_uncovered_changed_line_fails_the_gate + test_covering_the_changed_line_passes_the_gate + test_line_shifting_uncommitted_edits_use_one_coherent_final_snapshot + test_the_combined_xml_is_repo_relative_so_diff_cover_can_match_it + test_the_f0_cli_stops_on_an_under_covered_diff_then_passes_once_covered + test_the_runner_records_a_real_race_and_never_auto_closes_it PASSED; full integration root 444 passed, 2 deselected; final post-integration canonical F0 18/18 units GREEN in 4.0 min, pinned diff-cover 10.3.0 PASS at 93% over 335 changed lines
